title: Copilot Studio: MCP-compliant tools in agents and workflows
notes: claim 68: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page

reasons: published before the check existed: kept live with a notice while a corrected version is prepared

summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly extends connector endpoint filtering to custom connectors and recommends end-user-only credentials without warning that this breaks autonomous agents. Standard-harness billing now uses Copilot Credits, not messages, and the Microsoft 365 registry control links to a missing page. The default-state field and several availability and governance claims also need correction.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Requiring end-user credentials is an unqualified production control for the MCP agents described, including autonomous agents.
claims.quote: agents triggered by scheduled or autonomous events, or that attempt to run in the background, fail due to missing credentials. All agent triggers must involve an active user.

Warn that disabling maker credentials changes existing and new agents immediately and causes scheduled/autonomous/background agents to fail; assess those agents before enforcing it. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/configure-no-maker-authentication.

claims.claim: Advanced connector policies can block entire MCP servers.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 registry governs only Copilot Chat access and does not affect Copilot Studio agents on other channels.
claims.quote: The policy you set for each tool applies wherever the tool is used and is enforced at runtime by the Agent 365 Tooling Gateway.
claims.fix: Remove the channel-based exclusion. Explain that registry controls apply to supported registered servers/tools through Agent 365, and approval and consent make registered servers available in Copilot Studio environments; coverage is determined by the registered-server/gateway integration, not simply the publication channel.

claims.claim: A general tenant-level MCP server allowlist independent of connector policies is not established by the sources checked.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio MCP tenant allowlist servers governance. Read advanced-connector-policies, microsoft-agent-365/admin/manage-plugins-skills-mcp-servers and BYO search excerpt; found registered-server controls, not a universal allowlist for all Studio MCP connections.

claims.claim: How server tool-description changes are surfaced to Copilot Studio administrators remains undocumented in the checked material.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio MCP tool changes notifications administrators. Read agent-extend-action-mcp, agents-experience/tools-add-mcp-server and tools-manage search excerpt; no administrator change-notification mechanism found.

claims.claim: The relevant controls are not configured by default in most tenants.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio MCP most tenants. Read admin-data-loss-prevention, security-and-governance and configure-no-maker-authentication; no evidence establishes the configuration of most tenants.
claims.fix: Remove the claim about most tenants. Retain the high-risk analysis based on documented external tools, server-supplied descriptions and write capabilities, without asserting tenant population statistics.

claims.claim: The optional maker-selected capability is assigned prepare.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; "A maker adds an MCP server as a tool"; "not a change to default Copilot behaviour."
claims.fix: Set action to review: the schema assigns optional capabilities chosen by a maker to review, and no verified source states that this change automatically adds MCP tools to existing agents.

claims.claim: The checklist recommends enforcing end-user credentials, but the controls table has no credential-policy row.
claims.quote: "Require end-user credentials for MCP connections in production environments." The five control rows contain no maker-credential policy.
claims.fix: Add a credential-policy row citing https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/configure-no-maker-authentication, with the autonomous-agent caveat. The documented environment path is Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Copilot Studio agents > Control maker credential options.

claims.claim: The checklist recommends tool approval, but the controls table has no approval row.
claims.quote: "Enable human approval for write-capable tools where the harness supports it." No control row covers end-user confirmation.
claims.fix: Add a maker-side confirmation row using https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/add-tools-custom-agent: Tools > tool > Details > Ask the end user before running. Qualify its harness and interactive-user scope.

claims.claim: The checklist recommends reviewing connector dependency insights, but the table has no corresponding row.
claims.quote: "Review connector dependency insights in the Power Platform admin center quarterly"; the controls table has no dependency-insights row.
claims.fix: Add a connector dependency insights row sourced from https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/security-and-governance. Do not invent a navigation path: either research its exact surface or keep this as a general note rather than a checklist instruction.

claims.claim: The checklist recommends Purview audit review, but the table has no audit row.
claims.quote: "Audit tool call activity in Purview"; none of the control rows covers audit.
claims.fix: Add a Purview audit row with its documented search surface and automation equivalent after checking https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/ai-copilot-studio, linked by the cited security-and-governance page; otherwise keep audit as a general note without an instruction to configure it.

claims.claim: The checklist recommends per-agent consumption monitoring, but the table has no consumption row.
claims.quote: "Track Copilot Credit consumption by agent"; the table has no credit-consumption row.
claims.fix: Add a per-agent consumption-monitoring row using the agent's Monitor page and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/billing-credit-overview. Keep tenant/environment reporting distinct from per-agent reporting.
